title: Hidden changes
notes: Keep one adult at each table and rotate sender, changer and receiver; an adult can record a key without choosing it. On another visit, K-1 can invent and collect reliable short keys (P3-4), then compare partners or try a third picture (P5-6). Grades 2-3 can return to a shortest-key argument (P3-4), four pictures (P5), or two hidden changes (P6). Grades 4-5 can use the received-row collections to justify separation and minimum length (P3-6). Retain successful and ambiguous rows as evidence for the next investigation.
